title: 'Outskirts of Town' with Eddie Vinson and the old Rushing session finally issued
summary: On the 1979-80 Muse album with Eddie 'Cleanhead' Vinson and Arnett Cobb she made up choruses and jokes. Columbia then issued for the first time a 1950s session she had made with Jimmy Rushing.
